stories.title: Madeiran Madalena Costa breaks record and retains world title
stories.short_summary:
Madeiran Madalena Costa, 17, retained the senior world title in free figure skating at the World Skate Games in Asunción, Paraguay, and set a new record with 264.69 points [dnoticias.pt#1][madeira-weekly.com#1]. The athlete from Sporting Clube Santacruzense scored 171.91 points in the free skate, after earning 92.78 in the short program [dnoticias.pt#1].

Costa won the title for the second consecutive year. Spain's Sira Gallarda came second with 220.41 points, and her compatriot Elna Frances placed third with 187.01 [dnoticias.pt#1][madeira-weekly.com#1].
talking_points: Competition: The event brought together 35 skaters; Portugal's Letícia Marinho finished in seventh place [dnoticias.pt#1][madeiraislanddirect.com#1].
Portuguese medals: João Cruz won gold and Rita Azinheira won bronze in the junior categories, bringing Portugal's skating medal tally at this edition to three [dnoticias.pt#1][madeira-weekly.com#1].
Under-19 hockey: Portugal's under-19 roller hockey team finished the Games as world runners-up [dnoticias.pt#2][funchalnoticias.net#1].

perspectives.text: António José Seguro, President of the Republic: In his congratulatory message, he attributed the results to the dedication of the athletes, coaches, families, clubs, and the Portuguese Skating Federation [dnoticias.pt#2].

stories.title: Ventura calls at Funchal with 3,104 passengers on board
stories.short_summary:
The cruise ship Ventura called at Funchal on Sunday, October 11, with 3,104 passengers and 1,172 crew members on board, for a total of 4,276 people [jm-madeira.pt#1][funchalnoticias.net#1]. It arrived from La Palma in the Canary Islands at around 7:15 a.m. and departed at 5:30 p.m. for Cádiz, Spain [funchalnoticias.net#1].

The call was part of a 14-night cruise that began in Southampton on October 3 and was scheduled to return to the same port on October 17 [funchalnoticias.net#1]. Before reaching Madeira, the ship visited Lanzarote, Gran Canaria, Tenerife, and La Palma [funchalnoticias.net#1].
talking_points: Maximum capacity: Built in 2008 by the Italian shipyard Fincantieri, Ventura can carry up to 3,700 passengers [funchalnoticias.net#1].
Next call: The arrival of National Geographic Endurance in Funchal was scheduled for Monday, October 12, with 147 passengers and 70 crew members [funchalnoticias.net#1].
